assignments.name: report

instructions: This workflow builds a read-only weekly report using only the 'observe' tool profile.
1. Create an 'Algenta API' credential pointing at your own self-hosted Algenta engine's base
URL (e.g. http://localhost:8000), with an API key if your engine requires one, and attach it
2. Get Contract discovers the connected engine's capabilities.
3. Fetch Weekly Metrics runs a governed query_data call against the 'weekly_renewals' dataset.
Replace the dataset name with one that exists in your own engine.
4. Forecast Next Week runs a simulate call for the next-week renewal forecast scenario.
5. Recommend Action runs a recommend call for the next-week renewal recommendation scenario.
6. Render Weekly Report combines the outputs into a single Markdown report item.
Every Algenta node in this workflow is pinned to the 'observe' profile, so no decision can be
